notes:
A big one: the audio player is real.

NEW AUDIO PLAYER
- Five controls in one row: previous, rewind, play/pause, forward, next.
- Play and pause are now a single button that changes with the state.
- Rewind and forward use the interval you choose in Settings.
- Previous and next move between surahs, or between paras, depending on what you opened.

FOUR SLIDERS THAT STAY IN STEP
- Time, ayah, ruku and para. Move any one and the others follow, because all four describe the same position in the recitation.
- With TalkBack, swipe up and down on a slider to move it one step at a time.
- Each slider speaks in real words: "Ayah 5", "Ruku 3", "3 minutes 42 seconds", "Para 5, past Nisf". No percentages.
- The value is spoken again whenever you return to the slider.
- Choose which sliders you want in Settings, and how big each step is.

LISTEN WITH THE SCREEN OFF
- Recitation now continues in the background, with controls on the notification and the lock screen.
- It pauses for calls and when headphones are unplugged, and stops at the end of a surah or para.

PARA AUDIO
- Paras now play. Choosing a para plays it straight through, across surahs, announcing the surah name with each ayah.

RECITER
- Choose your reciter in Settings: Mishary Alafasy or Abdul Basit Murattal.

CORRECTIONS
- Para 4 began one ayah early. It starts at 3:93, as it should. All thirty para boundaries were checked against two independent sources.
- Every ayah in the Quran was measured for its exact length, so positions and seeking are precise rather than estimated.
